candidates.name: decrease_contact_penalty_scale
candidates.hypothesis: Reducing the contact penalty will encourage less aggressive interactions that may lead to contact.
candidates.rationale: Lowering the penalty may help agents to avoid panic braking and maintain close racing without excessive penalties.

candidates.name: increase_overtake_bonus
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing the overtaking bonus will promote cleaner overtaking strategies, reducing the likelihood of collisions.
candidates.rationale: A higher reward for overtaking can incentivize agents to seek valid passing opportunities without targeting aggressive maneuvers.

candidates.name: reduce_hook_contact_penalty
candidates.hypothesis: Reducing the hook contact penalty can allow agents to maintain speed while negotiating close proximity with opponents.
candidates.rationale: Minimizing penalties for hook contacts may reduce panic reactions leading to more consistent and stable behavior.
